   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 16, 2026 - Nov 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _eBayX_, Nov 23, 2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately, the app is broken and will not connect with Garmin Connect since its new updated version. I submitted a message and was told it is broken for the foreseeable future. Don’t recommend at this time."
            2. _Guillidou_, Nov 21, 2026, 1/5: "This app was fantastic until they decided to update it to a new version recently. Now it just crashes all the time. Sometimes you can’t even log in. Some of the features are gone from the mobile up, like creating a meal from what you have logged as your lunch etc in the diary or completing your nutrition for the day to check how many weeks to lose some weight. I do not recommend this app anymore unless they go back to the way it was before :("
            3. _Pramey96_, Nov 12, 2026, 1/5: "New update has ruined the app. Interface is both more complicated and provides less functionality at the same time. It is also very buggy, for example not allowing you to press controls at the bottom of the iPhone which makes some features unusable. The old app used to work so well. Bring it back!"
